Do I need coding experience before joining a project squad?
Where is the next Next.js workshop taking place?

reply.body: Our Modern Web & Next.js Workshop will be held at Lab IT-302, Faculty of ICT on 10 Dec 2026 at 16:30. Bring your laptop!

inquiries.question: How do I apply for the Design & Art or UX/UI Designer role?

reply.body: Open /joining-information, select UX/UI Designer under Projects Team (or Graphic Designer under Marketing Team), and attach your portfolio or Figma link.

faqBank.question: How many hours per week does a project squad require?
faqBank.answer: Most squads meet once a week for 1.5–2 hours and coordinate async tasks around exam periods.

faqBank.question: Can DST students apply for Projects Team roles?
faqBank.answer: Yes! Both ICT and DST students from Years 1–4 are welcome across all engineering, design, QA, and marketing tracks.

faqBank.question: Can I switch teams after joining for one semester?
faqBank.answer: Yes, members can rotate between tracks at the start of a new project cycle after talking with their squad lead.
